pagination.$comment: A row of buttons that moves through the pages of a collection. It paints almost nothing of its own: a pager stands on the page's surface, not on a panel of its own, so the tokens are the gap between the items, the item box on the shared control axis, the three colours a page label wears (rest, hover, current) and the muted marker that stands for a folded run of pages. The current page is the one place the accent appears — it is filled, because `aria-current` is the only other channel and a forced-colours mode drops the fill.
pagination.$comment-item-height: Every button in the strip — a page number and a stepper alike — is an `item`. The box tracks the token shared with the field and the button ({pct.control.height}), so a pager lines up with a control of the same size (`req-api-size`). The `-sm` / `-lg` variants swap the base tokens; size `md` keeps to them.

item-height-sm.$description: Height of an item at size sm.

item-height-lg.$description: Height of an item at size lg.

pagination.$comment-item-target-min: The floor a finger gets, so it is the floor an eye sees at every skin (`req-a11y-touch`). The height above clears it at the default type size; this is what a theme that shrinks the control axis runs into — the tabs' `tab-target-min`, one component over.

item-padding-x-sm.$description: Horizontal padding of an item at size sm.

item-padding-x-lg.$description: Horizontal padding of an item at size lg.

item-font-size-sm.$description: Font size of an item at size sm.

item-font-size-lg.$description: Font size of an item at size lg.

item-font-weight-selected.$description: Font weight of an item when selected.

pagination.$comment-item-bg: Equal to the page surface rather than `transparent`, so the contrast gate has a concrete partner to measure the label against — visually it is the same thing on a surface-coloured page.

item-bg-hover.$description: Background of an item on hover.

item-fg-hover.$description: Text colour of an item on hover.

item-fg-disabled.$description: Text colour of an item while disabled.

pagination.$comment-item-selected: The page you are on: filled with the accent, because `aria-current` is the only channel left once a forced-colours mode removes the fill, and a quiet outline would not read as 'here' next to eight other buttons. Named `selected` for the token dictionary; the DOM attribute is `data-pct-current`, which cannot be mistaken for another entrypoint's selector (4.13, the tabs' and calendar's workaround made a rule).

item-bg-selected.$description: Background of an item when selected.

item-fg-selected.$description: Text colour of an item when selected.

item-border-selected.$description: Edge colour of an item when selected.

marker-fg.$description: Text colour of the fold's ellipsis between page numbers.
